title: kate-core: accept yes and no as booleans
summary: bool_value accepts the words yes and no. The words true and false stay valid. The test goes in the existing config tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: config.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Change only bool_value. The body is one match. "true" | "yes" returns Ok(true). "false" | "no" returns Ok(false). Any other word returns Err(bad_value(key)). Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not match Ok or Err by hand. Do not fold ASCII case. Do not touch editor_config_to_toml, width_value, trailing_value, apply_document, raw_rhs, or set_version. The existing document_section_maps_to_default_document test stays green. The test yes_and_no_are_booleans parses format_version = 1, document.indent_with_spaces = yes, and document.ensure_trailing_newline = no. indent_with_spaces is true. ensure_trailing_newline is false. The same parser rejects document.indent_with_spaces = YES with ConfigError::BadValue for that key. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: config::tests::yes_and_no_are_booleans
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. The word yes is a bad value. After the change yes is true and no is false. The word YES stays a bad value. true and false stay valid.
